vulnerability.name: USN-9119-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that PDFResurrect did not properly validate certain size values when loading PDF pages. If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted PDF file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause PDFResurrect to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2019-14934)  It was discovered that PDFResurrect did not properly validate the header of PDF files, leading to a heap buffer overflow. If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted PDF file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause PDFResurrect to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2020-20740)

statements.status_notes: PDFResurrect could be made to crash or run programs as your login if it opened a specially crafted file. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
